title: Audit: crypto2dev 2026-04-19
notes:
UAPI stability risk: LOW — struct layouts are padding-clean, all reserved fields validated in write-direction ioctls, string null-termination consistent across all handlers, tombstoned slots return -ENOTTY correctly; two minor GET_STATE diagnostic gaps found (outbuf_pending not reported for KEY fds, inbuf_pending not reported for UNSET fds)
Confidence: FIPS gate coverage: 97% (16 provider files exhaustively checked, zero violations — residual risk is callbacks added in future without following the pattern; one idiom question 533.18 needs live fips.h to close). Key material leak risk: 10% (two real leaks found SHA/keygen-inbuf; CBC zero-IV adds a reuse path; remaining risk is a path not exercised in static review). UAPI stability: LOW (structs padding-clean, all reserved fields validated, tombstones correct; two GET_STATE diagnostic gaps). Gaps: cannot verify wolfssl_fips_gate correctness without real wolfcrypt.ko fips.h; no lockdep run to catch lock ordering; no dynamic test coverage data showing all error paths exercised. Would raise confidence with: (1) lockdep run under KVM with all providers loaded, (2) CMVP lab verification of fips_gate idiom, (3) sparse/smatch static analysis pass.
